g.text: The exponential carries every output cut
An exact comparison normalization with the target fixed
L = [b,H] = bH + Hb
G = exp(L), G⁻¹ = exp(−L)
A whole chain cooperad automorphism
The series is finite on each original tree.
The full polynomial interval path
G̃ = exp(tL) + dt H exp(tL)
dt is on the left; G̃(0) = 1, G̃(1) = G
The chain equation and every cut hold over k[t,dt].
The first nonlinear word is necessary
a = E_ef, c = E_ff, w = sa|sc|sa|sc
L(sa|sc) = −s1, L²(w) = 2s1|s1
G(w) = w + L(w) + s1|s1
The ordinary output word s1|s1 repairs the middle cut.
F → F exp(L)
(FG)₂ = f₂ + ∂h₂; higher components follow the flow.
